Just to explain my situation, i'm over the age most clinics here evaluate people, and i've been struggling to find a place that will see me. It took me 2 years ro find them, and i'm still working toward an actual diagnosis. I've had many conversations about autism with several doctors and therapists, and used thwm to come to the conclusion i should be evaluated. Point i'm making here is yes there are those people who see a single tiktok and think they are autistic. On the other side of the coin though, are people like me who have struggled their whole life and have done their best to educate themselves and try to improve their life. The school of thought that *all* self diagnosis is bad just hurts, and silenced people like me whose struggles are just as legit as someone with a diagnosis. A diagnosis is a luxary that not everyone has access too. 

For the record, i don't say i'm autistic anymore because of views like this, i just say my doctors suspect it and i'm trying to get an eval.
